British Amern Tob Plc (BTI) Shareholder Cordasco Financial Network Has Trimmed Its Holding; Heritage Investors Management Has Increased Holding in Altria Group (MO)
May 10, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Cordasco Financial Network decreased its stake in British Amern Tob Plc (BTI) by 45.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cordasco Financial Network sold 5,429 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.55% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,597 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $442,000, down from 12,026 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cordasco Financial Network who had been investing in British Amern Tob Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $109.31B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.04% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $52.72. About 1.08 million shares traded. British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSEMKT:BTI) has declined 15.61% since May 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.16% the S&P500.
Heritage Investors Management Corp increased its stake in Altria Group Inc (MO) by 2.15% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Heritage Investors Management Corp bought 4,316 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.83% with the market. The institutional investor held 204,739 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.62M, up from 200,423 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Heritage Investors Management Corp who had been investing in Altria Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $106.71 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $0.41 during the last trading session, reaching $56.33. About 2.35M shares traded. Altria Group, Inc. (NYSE:MO) has declined 17.05% since May 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.60% the S&P500.
Among 7 analysts covering British Amrcn Tobacco ( NYSEMKT:BTI ), 5 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. British Amrcn Tobacco had 9 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSE:BTI) has “Buy” rating given on Friday, October 28 by Societe Generale. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, August 4 by Bank of America. As per Thursday, May 25, the company rating was initiated by Piper Jaffray. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, November 2 by Morgan Stanley. The company was initiated on Tuesday, August 25 by Cowen & Co. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, August 4 by Investec. As per Friday, July 29, the company rating was downgraded by Societe Generale. Goldman Sachs downgraded British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSE:BTI) on Thursday, December 10 to “Sell” rating. The stock of British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSE:BTI) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, September 8 by Investec.
